title: Sunday · the ridge from the motel roof
logline: The ridge from the motel's roof at dawn after a shift: the town below, the bay, the ridge with a faint warmth over it the tier doesn't explain. The second time the glow is drawn.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the motel's flat roof at dawn, a man sitting on the parapet from behind in a maroon polo, the town below.

image.prompt: a man in a maroon polo sitting on a motel's roof parapet from behind at dawn with a small town below, watercolor

panels.name: Roof

panels.composition: Tier 2: the ridge beyond the town, dark, a faint warm glow over one part of it.

image.prompt: a wooded ridge beyond a small coastal town at dawn with a faint warm glow over one part of it, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Ridge

panels.composition: Tier 3: the man climbing down the roof ladder, the glow out of frame.

image.prompt: a man in a maroon polo climbing down a roof ladder on a motel at dawn, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Down

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: The glow, second drawing (after the Lanes 2009). Not explained.
